scope.S81-CONNECT: Bound every Vanguard HTTPS connection setup by the lesser of the configured connect timeout and the remaining total deadline, including pre-socket DNS/TCP work.
scope.S81-CANCEL: A connection setup that exceeds its bound fails closed, is cancelled or discarded when it later returns, and cannot issue the request, parse a response or publish evidence.
scope.S81-VERIFY: Add failed-first deterministic regressions for a nearly exhausted deadline and delayed pre-socket setup, preserve all Issue #79 transport and portfolio behavior, and record verification plus independent review evidence.

non_goals: No change to holdings parsing, exact ranking, freshness, evidence schema, screening, construction or allocation.
No broad HTTP-client replacement, new dependency, provider credential change or endpoint change.
No trade, brokerage connection or external financial-system write.

invariants.I81-DEADLINE: Connection setup returns success or a sanitized failure within min(configured connect timeout, remaining total deadline); total-deadline exhaustion is reported only as issuer_elapsed_limit.
invariants.I81-NO-LATE-CONTINUE: If pre-socket setup completes after the caller has timed out, its connection is closed or discarded and never reaches request, response, parsing or publication work.
invariants.I81-COMPAT: Fixed Vanguard host/path/TLS, three-attempt maximum, read timeout, header/body watchdog, byte/row limits, diagnostics, exact data results and every non-Vanguard path retain Issue #79 behavior.

acceptance.AC81-1: A nearly exhausted deadline passes the exact smaller positive remaining duration into connection setup instead of the fixed configured timeout.
acceptance.AC81-2: A deterministic delayed pre-socket setup returns to the caller within the remaining budget, reports issuer_elapsed_limit on deadline exhaustion and cannot continue the request after completing late.
acceptance.AC81-3: An ordinary configured connect-timeout expiry before the total deadline stays fail closed and does not become a raw exception or partial publication.
acceptance.AC81-4: Existing exact host/path, redirect, attempt, header/body slow-trickle, byte/row, parsing, live-source and portfolio tests remain green.

risks: A timed-out resolver or connector may return later and mutate a discarded connection unless cancellation ownership is explicit.
Thread or timer cleanup can leak resources or race with successful connection completion.
Changing timeout attribution can break retry semantics or expose raw connection errors.
escalation_triggers: The connection operation cannot be bounded without a new dependency or broad transport replacement.
The fix requires changing Issue #79 endpoint, retry, parsing, evidence or publication contracts.
Cancellation introduces unresolved concurrency, resource-leak or late-request ambiguity.
